# SM-01 — API input and contracts

<!-- Generated from build-standard.yaml by `pnpm gen:standard`. Do not edit by hand. -->

- **Kind:** Selectable
- **Applies when:** The app has an API or forms.
- **Catalogue:** v1.0.0 (ADR-0010)

## Lite
Schema validation on every input; invalid input returns 4xx and never reaches the database.

| Check | How | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| **SM-01-L1** Each route validates body, query and params against a schema; contract tests send invalid payloads and get 4xx. | auto + review | `test_report` |

## Full
Lite, plus contract tests generated from the API schema when frontend and backend are separate.

| Check | How | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| **SM-01-F1** Contract tests generated from the API schema pass against the running service. | auto | `test_report` |

## Code signals (mid-build detector, S5)
- Route handlers or form posts
  - code: `\b(app|router)\.(get|post|put|patch|delete)\(`
  - code: `\bexport (async )?function (GET|POST|PUT|PATCH|DELETE)\b`
  - code: `<form\b`
